cost_notes: Preview free and keyless; full API free with registration (rate-limited); no SLA or commercial support on the free tier.
free_tier: anonymous public preview (capped; the cap is not published on reachable pages, so treat it as UNKNOWN); free-tier subscription key by registration for the full API
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: the public preview endpoint WORKS keyless - /public/v1/preview/C/A/HS with reporterCode=842, period=2023, cmdCode=9018, flowCode=M returned HTTP 200 and 127 partner-level records (9018+9022+9402 together: 278 records).
The full data endpoint /data/v1/get/... returned HTTP 401 'Access denied due to missing subscription key' - the complete series needs a (free-tier) subscription key.
Preview responses are capped and truncated silently for large reporter/partner/period combinations; always reconcile the returned `count`.
In preview, descriptive fields (reporterDesc, partnerDesc, cmdDesc, reporterISO, partnerISO) come back null; only numeric codes are reliable, so labels need a separate code list.
No publication timestamp is exposed; annual values are only 'year' known, so the records are coarse-quality and excluded from lead-time claims.

Country-level HS-code AGGREGATE statistics only: no company, no shipment, no product identity. Must not be substituted for bill-of-lading (company-level) data, and cannot be used to infer any of the five firms' supply chain.
licence: UN Comtrade terms of use; free for non-commercial use with attribution, bulk redistribution restricted
rate_limits: preview not documented; keyed API rate-limited per subscription tier
research_value: Provides the macro demand/import-volume background for a medical-device HS code (9018, 9019, 9021, 9022, 9402) across nearly all reporters, which is a legitimate descriptive series. It is explicitly NOT evidence about any individual firm: it cannot name an importer, exporter, shipment or product.
timestamp_fields: period / refYear = calendar year (coarse) -> source_public_at can only be coarse
refMonth = Comtrade month code (52 = annual total), not a real publication date
no published_at field at all -> the API cannot say when a figure became public
update_frequency: annual (with revisions); monthly for reporting countries
